_note: Updatable catalog of selectable chat models. The app fetches this file from the repo at runtime (raw GitHub) so new models appear WITHOUT an app update; this bundled copy is the offline fallback. Each entry is just a HuggingFace repo + file: the app resolves the exact size and SHA256 live from HuggingFace (LFS oid) at download time, so no checksum maintenance is needed. 'sizeGB'/'paramsB' are approximate, used only for display and the VRAM range filter. 'default': true pre-selects the model at first run and shows the Recommended badge; 'recommended' is a short Italian hint shown under the model. To add a model: append an entry within the size range below and validate the repo/file exist on HuggingFace. 'modelsV2' holds models that need app >= 0.1.74 (reasoning models, run with a zero thought budget): older app versions read only 'models', so they never see them. 'rank' + 'minVramGB' drive the per-machine recommendation (model-default.mjs): the highest rank whose minVramGB fits the GPU's total VRAM; without GPU info the 'default' entry is used.
